scope: All approximately four-second gaps between retained train/val sequences, rounded to nearest second. Original-screen reasons, not a census of final exclusion causes or confirmed recoveries.

visual_sample.selection: Eight gaps with highest sum of left run, four-second gap, and right run; targeted, not random.

screening_issue: cheap_reasons requires player_present on every sampled frame; one miss excludes all four seconds and prevents joining retained neighbors. Damage flashes/projectile overlaps cause observed false missing-player flags.
policy: Stationary play and brief natural damage flashes/occlusions should preserve chronological continuity. Detector misses request contextual review; genuine cuts, menus, invalid class intervals and disallowed overlays still require boundaries. Never drop individual frames and stitch over them.
limitations: Only eight targeted gaps visually reviewed; no population false-positive rate established.
40 sampled frames per gap inspected, not all native-rate frames.
